description: PREFERRED EDIT tool for small/medium changes, and the ONLY edit tool safe on a page too large to read or re-emit in full: {"type": "append"} appends to the raw file server-side and needs no prior read_page and no revision/fileId (GH #632) — it is still subject to the page's byte size cap and will throw PageSizeError if the result exceeds it. Patch a page with surgical edits in one call. Returns bytesWritten (UTF-8 byte count of the file after patching). Supports text anchors and line-range replacement (replace_lines with 1-based line numbers over the page BODY only — the same 'content' field read_page returns, never counting YAML frontmatter), and accepts multiple operations in an array. Each operation MUST include a 'type' field (one of: replace, insert_after, insert_before, append, replace_lines). Example replace op: {"type": "replace", "find": "## Status\nOld text", "replace": "## Status\nNew text"}.
name: patch_page
